structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Ungranted Shores of the Sea, Marshes and Meadowlands
Inventories of Certain Ungranted Shores of the Sea, Marsh and Meadowlands

law.text: The failure to include any ungranted shores of the sea, marsh or meadowlands in an initial inventory shall not affect the Commonwealth's rights of ownership in such property.
